facts.fact: A data-policy training session held on 24 September 2025 in Antananarivo, part of a multi-day workshop run by Team Europe's Data Governance in Africa Action, brought together over 50 delegates from SADC, SATA, SAPOA and CRASA to discuss joint approaches to regional cooperation, data-sharing agreements and harmonised cross-border regulation.

systems.country_label: Communications Regulators' Association of Southern Africa

systems.system: Team Europe Data Governance in Africa Action

note: The workshop was organised by a European donor action, not by an African body; recorded as member only, with Madagascar as the host city.
